sourceMap.facts: INGV/CNR-ISMAR/Sapienza investigation of floating plastic using satellite data.
Two experiments in Lake Massaciuccoli and Gulf of La Spezia.
Artificial plastic island designed to mimic debris accumulations; radar imagery can distinguish it; water roughness and measured signal change.
SAR can work day/night/cloud cover; potential for more continuous future monitoring, not established universal operational service.
Results published in Remote Sensing of Environment.

excluded: Linked journal paper text and downloadable videos.
Unsupported claims about detecting individual bottles, all ocean plastic, or an already operational worldwide service.
